draft.profile: subgraph sampling: a technique used in mini-batch stochastic gradient descent for training graph neural networks. In this approach, each mini-batch operates on a subgraph that forms the union of the k-hop neighbors of the selected nodes. This subgraph, called a mini-batch subgraph, provides a localized computation structure for the update.
